scope: finite exact RK4 spectral counterexample plus future-only latch cost certificate

counterexample.nonlinear_term: 0 because every active velocity coefficient is transverse to both +k and -k
counterexample.conclusion: exact retained support can shrink from full support of this finite retained set to empty in one fixed RK4 step; support fullness is not a universal monotonic invariant

latch_regret.comparison: permanent dense latch now versus continuing exact route guard on K future calls
latch_regret.identity: C_latch-C_dynamic = L_switch + sum_{j in J}(D_j-S_j) - sum_i G_i
latch_regret.bounded_upper: C_latch-C_dynamic <= L_upper + M*U - H_guard when |J|<=M, D_j-S_j<=U, sum_i G_i>=H_guard, L_switch<=L_upper
latch_regret.critical_boundary: a dense/full-support snapshot alone does not certify M=0; a future sparse-opportunity bound must come from a separate invariant or measurement certificate

nonclaims: not a claim about the pinned production trajectory's support history
not a speedup or slowdown claim
